summary: Revise contract: Remove boundary limits from Dockside mobile thread navigation. When the queue reaches the last thread, next arrow or left swipe wraps to the first thread; when at the first thread, previous arrow or right swipe wraps to the last thread. Keep singleton queues disabled and preserve the current active/unread ordering.
